topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found it tucked away in a corner of the attic, a little book bound in soft, weathered leather. Each page was filled with words that danced like the light through leaves. It was a novel, yes, but not just any story. It was my story, seen through their eyes, woven with threads of imagination and truth. It’s as if every moment we’ve shared, every whisper, every silence, had found its way onto these pages. It took my breath away. I’m eager to turn each page, to see how our lives look when spun into tales. I can’t wait to share this with them, to laugh and marvel at how our days have turned into a love story.
